nodes.description: Fancm knockout mice have hypogonadism, crosslinker-sensitive embryonic fibroblasts and reduced tumor-free survival, without the full Fanconi anemia picture.

Males show spermatogenic failure with germ cell loss, Sertoli cell-only tubules and round spermatid arrest, and spermatogonia are hypersensitive to mitomycin C. No marrow failure or tumors were seen in adult mice.

Biallelic truncating variants remove full-length FANCM. FANCM is a structure-specific DNA translocase whose ATPase motor activity is needed to resist DNA crosslinkers; it remodels stalled replication forks and recombination intermediates. No full-length FANCM was detected in blood from the Pakistani patients.

nodes.description: Germ cells are lost from the seminiferous tubules, leaving Sertoli cells only in the most severe cases. In mice, Fancm loss reduces primordial germ cells before birth and then progressively depletes spermatogonial stem cells with age. Human testis biopsies show the end state, Sertoli cell-only tubules; whether the human loss is also progressive is not known.
